races.name: Classic Car Show On 9th June Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bontessony Doll
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with unknown going preference creates uncertainty, lightly raced profile makes assessment difficult.

runners_data.name: Medina Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form, Grace Harris yard in good form with 4/16 winners in last fortnight.

runners_data.name: Gone Away Madam
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner and course winner, 760 days off concerning but Jack Quinlan booking suggests readiness.

runners_data.name: Arctic Voyage
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer with recent victory, form figures suggest he needs others to go hard early.

runners_data.name: Jubertilee
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse but 9-year-old legs may struggle with younger rivals over this trip.

runners_data.name: Keep Off The Sugar
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but concerning fade tendency, 57 days since last run suggests freshness questions.

runners_data.name: Lirone Du Seuil
runners_data.note: Dan Skelton runner with strong hold-up style, 10/30 stable form provides confidence in preparation.

runners_data.name: Arbitration
runners_data.note: Front-runner from Joe Tizzard yard, recent Flat form suggests fitness but jumping test awaited.

runners_data.name: Blue Siam
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 5lb claimer, lightweight advantage offset by modest recent form figures.

runners_data.name: Louis Des Landes
runners_data.note: Unknown style creates tactical questions, Joe Tizzard second string suggests supporting role likely.

races.paceDynamic: Gone Away Madam and Arbitration will contest the early lead, with Gone Away Madam's proven front-running style likely to dominate from the off. This creates an honest gallop over 2m1f that should suit horses with tactical pace rather than pure hold-up merchants. The presence of two committed leaders means the pace won't collapse, creating a searching test from halfway. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina reserves who can sit close enough to strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Gone Away Madam and Arbitration go too hard early and fade from 2 out
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for horses racing in behind with finishing kicks. Arctic Voyage and Lirone Du Seuil benefit most from their hold-up styles when others have emptied their tanks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Gone Away Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Away Madam gets easy lead and controls tempo with Arbitration struggling to match
scenarios.body: Her proven front-running ability and course winner status allows her to dictate throughout. The mare's stamina reserves prove decisive when challenged late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Arbitration Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Arbitration improves from recent Flat form and outstays Gone Away Madam in final furlong
scenarios.body: The younger legs and Joe Tizzard stable form advantage shows when the pace intensifies. His stamina breeding comes to the fore when others tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Holds Strong
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain strong gallop to line with no significant weakening
scenarios.body: The searching test from the front eliminates most hold-up horses who get too far back. Only those close enough throughout can respond when needed.

watchPoints.text: Gone Away Madam's jumping after 760 days absence - any early mistakes could derail front-running tactics completely
Arctic Voyage's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance when leaders weaken to utilize finishing kick
Arbitration's jumping fluency early - recent Flat form means hurdling sharpness uncertain despite fitness advantage
Medina Blue's settling ability - prominent style could get caught up in early pace battle between the two leaders
Keep Off The Sugar's finishing effort - history shows fading tendency so early position crucial for any chance

races.name: Day Before Terry Wheeler's Birthday Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Evening Tess
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with uncontested lead likely, Harry Skelton knows how to exploit tactical advantages and recent second suggests fitness is there.

runners_data.name: Isabella Islay
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 49-day break with excellent recent win, but faces tactical disadvantage against lone pace-setter.

runners_data.name: Georgia's Charm
runners_data.note: Hold-up style facing wrong race shape, apprentice jockey adds pressure in tactical contest requiring perfect timing.

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Highest-rated on 100 but hold-up style and 33-day layoff work against her in this pace scenario.

runners_data.name: Yanka Blue
runners_data.note: Recent run gives fitness edge but hold-up style means relying on pace collapse to be effective from rear.

runners_data.name: Reel Orange
runners_data.note: Fresh from seven-day turnaround with winning form but must overcome hold-up disadvantage in tactical race.

runners_data.name: Miss Pearl
runners_data.note: Massive 385-day absence makes her hard to assess despite veteran experience in similar company.

runners_data.name: Kylenoe Dancer
runners_data.note: Only prominent racer besides leader, recent Cheltenham win gives confidence and tactical position suits.

races.paceDynamic: Evening Tess will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with only Kylenoe Dancer likely to race prominently early. With six hold-up horses behind them, Evening Tess should get an uncontested lead and dictate terms throughout. The pace will be honest but not punishing, allowing the leader to maintain energy for the finish. This tactical setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers, as the hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground against horses who've stolen a march.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Tess gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The mare will build an insurmountable advantage over hurdles while the hold-up horses play catch-up too late. Her recent second form and Harry Skelton's tactical awareness make her perfectly placed to exploit this pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: Class horses like Isabella Islay and Blackwater Lilly can unleash finishing kicks when the race opens up late. Their superior ratings and proven finishing ability become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Kylenoe Dancer tracks Evening Tess closely and pounces at the last
scenarios.body: The eight-year-old's recent Cheltenham win shows her in good heart, and prominent position gives her first run on the leaders when they tire. Tom Bellamy can time his challenge perfectly from this tactical berth.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Tess fails to maintain gallop or makes jumping errors
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last flight where raw class tells and the highest-rated finishers prevail. This chaos scenario opens the door for any of the hold-up horses with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Evening Tess jumping - any early mistakes could hand race to hold-up horses when she needs clean rounds to maintain advantage
Isabella Islay's fitness returning from 49-day break - class horse but needs to be wound up for tactical disadvantage
Kylenoe Dancer's early positioning - if she sits closer than expected to Evening Tess it changes the entire pace dynamic
Pace through first mile - if Evening Tess goes too fast early the hold-up horses get their preferred scenario
Blackwater Lilly's jumping rhythm - veteran mare needs to travel smoothly to overcome tactical deficit from rear

races.name: Racing Welfare Supporting Mental Health Awareness Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Anyharminasking
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 43-day break faces tactical disadvantage in small field where pace may not develop properly for his closing style.

runners_data.name: Move With The Beat
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent recent form including course win, claiming jockey takes off useful weight but adds inexperience factor.

runners_data.name: Siam Park
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner likely to get uncontested lead but recent form shows inconsistency with falls, though proven effective over course and distance.

runners_data.name: Inca De Lafayette
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from top yard with solid recent win but carrying top weight and stepping up in trip from recent shorter efforts.

races.paceDynamic: Siam Park will take them along from the front in this small field, likely getting an uncontested lead with Move With The Beat and Inca De Lafayette sitting prominent but not pressuring early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Siam Park can dictate terms and potentially kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horse Anyharminasking gets into gear. With only four runners and one confirmed leader, this sets up perfectly for front-runners and prominent racers who can travel into the race and have first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Siam Park gets soft fractions and isn't pressured by the prominent horses
scenarios.body: Siam Park dictates terms throughout and has enough left to repel late challenges, especially with his proven course form. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to control the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Move With The Beat or Inca De Lafayette pressure Siam Park early and take over
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run on Anyharminasking and their superior recent form tells as they battle out the finish. Move With The Beat's excellent recent record makes him the likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Anyharminasking gets a perfect setup
scenarios.body: The three front-runners go too fast early or stop quickly, allowing Anyharminasking to use his class advantage. However, his 43-day break and preference for softer ground makes this less likely on good ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses fail to handle the extended trip or ground conditions
scenarios.body: Form goes out the window as horses struggle with the distance or bounce back from poor runs. This chaotic scenario could see any horse win if the favorites underperform dramatically.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Siam Park gets early pressure from Move With The Beat or Inca De Lafayette as he's shown tendency to fold when challenged hard
Monitor Anyharminasking's jumping early as he needs to stay close in this small field to have any chance from his hold-up style
Check how Move With The Beat handles Isabelle Ryder's claiming inexperience in tight tactical situations despite the weight allowance
Observe if Inca De Lafayette can handle the step up to 2m5f as his recent wins have come over shorter trips
Watch the early fractions as Siam Park may go too fast if feeling pressure or too slow if left completely alone

races.name: Come Racing On 27th May Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Blacksamssenorita
runners_data.note: Front-running style suits the lack of early pace pressure, 36-day break freshens her up, and recent win at Hereford shows she's in form.

runners_data.name: Cobbler's Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style provides tactical advantage if pace becomes strong, Harry Skelton's excellent 33% strike-rate for the stable is notable, just 7 days since last run.

runners_data.name: Ellerton
runners_data.note: Returns from 167-day layoff which is a significant concern despite his class, prominent style suits if fit enough to do himself justice.

runners_data.name: One Island
runners_data.note: Four-year-old gets weight relief at bottom of handicap, prominent style allows him to track the pace, but needs to build on recent moderate efforts.

runners_data.name: Stinginhisstep
runners_data.note: Veteran campaigner with consistent recent form, prominent style keeps him involved, but needs career-best effort to win this grade.

races.paceDynamic: Blacksamssenorita will likely lead from the start with her prominent style and proven front-running ability, setting a steady tempo that won't be heavily pressured early. The other four runners all show prominent tendencies but Cobbler's Boy's hold-up style suggests he'll track from further back initially. With limited early pace pressure on the leader, this sets up for a sustained gallop that will test stamina reserves over the final 3-4 furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and have the class to quicken when the race develops in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Blacksamssenorita Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Blacksamssenorita gets an uncontested lead and maintains her jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: She can control the tempo throughout and prove hard to peg back with her recent winning form and proven ability at this trip. Her 36-day break and prominent racing style are perfectly suited to leading throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing and the leader weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Cobbler's Boy's hold-up style comes into play as he can pick off tiring leaders with his proven finishing kick. His recent win and Harry Skelton's 33% strike-rate for Dan Skelton provides strong tactical ammunition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If One Island or Ellerton can track the leader closely and challenge from the final bend
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained One Island has shown good recent form and gets a handy weight, while Ellerton returns from a long break with proven class. Both can sit handy and strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Blacksamssenorita goes too fast early or multiple horses challenge her lead simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where stamina trumps speed, potentially allowing an outsider like Stinginhisstep to emerge from the pack. The veteran's recent consistent form could see him benefit from a messy pace scenario.

watchPoints.text: Ellerton's fitness after 167 days off - any market support would be significant given the long absence
Blacksamssenorita's jumping under pressure - if challenged early her rhythm could falter
Cobbler's Boy's positioning in the early stages - needs to be within striking distance turning for home
One Island's response to pressure - has yet to win over hurdles and needs to prove his effectiveness
The pace development after the first mile - if it quickens dramatically it will test stamina reserves

races.name: St. Austell Brewery Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Certainly Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 67 days off with headgear first-time, needs strong pace to be effective but veteran class could shine through

runners_data.name: Viroflay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who will control the race unchallenged, solid recent form but 5lb claimer Miss Nicholls takes over from stronger pilot

runners_data.name: Hoe Joly Smoke
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with excellent trainer form (Dan Skelton 11/33) and significant weight advantage at just 156lbs, tongue-tie suggests breathing aid needed

runners_data.name: Lord Baddesley
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse freshest with just 9 days since last run, wears cheekpieces and visor but moderate recent form is concerning

races.paceDynamic: Viroflay is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will dictate proceedings from the front, with three hold-up horses (Certainly Red, Hoe Joly Smoke, Lord Baddesley) tracking behind. The prominent runner will face no early pressure over this stamina-sapping 3m2f trip, allowing him to control fractions and kick for home when ready. With such a small field and no pace pressure, the race will become a tactical affair decided by who can produce the strongest finish from off the pace. This shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can stay and finish, as they'll get the perfect stalking trip behind uncontested fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Viroflay gets easy fractions and stays the extended trip
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner controls every call and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. His prominent style becomes a winning advantage when unopposed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Staying Finisher
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses produces a sustained late rally
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as superior stamina tells over the final half-mile. Skelton's 12lb weight advantage for Hoe Joly Smoke could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If Certainly Red's higher rating (OR 137) overcomes his 12-year age
scenarios.body: The veteran finds enough despite the long absence to get up in the final strides. His proven class at this level gives him the edge in a finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Viroflay stops suddenly after controlling the race
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader pays for soft early fractions when multiple challengers swamp him late. Any of the hold-up trio could capitalize on his demise.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Viroflay gets any early pressure as the 5lb claimer may struggle to control fractions effectively in testing ground
Monitor Certainly Red's jumping after 67-day break, especially with first-time headgear potentially affecting his vision over fences
Check if Hoe Joly Smoke travels strongly into contention given his recent disappointing efforts suggest declining form
Observe Lord Baddesley's position turning for home as his fresh condition could give him an edge in a staying battle
Watch the pace through the early stages as overly slow fractions could set up a sprint finish that changes the complexion completely

races.name: Totnes And Bridgetown Chase Company Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Regatta De Blanc
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer whose place record (0W1P recent) suggests he finds one too good but stays well at this trip.

runners_data.name: Golden Son
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with class edge (OR 130) returning to form, Paul Nicholls' 34-day break looks well-judged for this target.

runners_data.name: Get Off Your Phone
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced 7-year-old with unknown going preferences creates tactical uncertainty, 7lb claim valuable if improved.

runners_data.name: High Game Royal
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape, recent 12-day turnaround shows connections are confident after consistent placed efforts.

runners_data.name: Fongs Way
runners_data.note: Long absence (1092 days) is major concern despite prominent running style, needs to prove fitness at this demanding trip.

runners_data.name: Est Illic
runners_data.note: Veteran 12-year-old with moderate rating (OR 84) faces class deficit, though recent third on good going shows he retains ability.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Son will set the early pace from the front with his proven leading ability, likely joined or pressed by Regatta De Blanc and High Game Royal in the opening stages. With most runners adopting prominent styles, there will be competitive early pace but nothing unsustainable given the 3m2f trip. The sustained gallop over this extended distance will test stamina reserves, creating a searching test in the final half-mile. This race shape favours horses with proven staying power and tactical speed who can position prominently early without over-racing.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Golden Son Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Son establishes an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: His class edge (OR 130) and front-running style perfectly suit the tactical setup, allowing him to control the race from pillar to post. The longer trip plays to his stamina strengths while his recent Cheltenham form shows he's back to his best.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses press Golden Son early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the pretenders from genuine stayers, with Regatta De Blanc's consistent place record suggesting he can capitalise. High Game Royal's recent good form on similar going makes him dangerous if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Get Off Your Phone's lightly-raced profile masks significant improvement
scenarios.body: His unknown going preferences create risk, but the 7lb claim and potential freshness could be decisive if others have gone too hard early. The Open Hunters' Chase format often produces surprises from improving types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too slow and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The veteran Est Illic could benefit from a tactical affair despite his low rating, while Fongs Way's long absence might have freshened him significantly. This scenario requires the front-runners to misjudge the fractions.

watchPoints.text: Golden Son's early fractions - if he gets an easy lead the others may struggle to peg him back over this stamina-sapping trip.
Get Off Your Phone's jumping under pressure given his lightly-raced profile and unknown going preferences could expose him late.
Regatta De Blanc's positioning in the first half-mile - needs to be handy but not over-racing to utilise his staying power.
High Game Royal's 12-day turnaround showing in his jumping rhythm - quick reappearances can affect concentration at these bigger obstacles.
The pace through the middle stages - if it becomes pedestrian it could set up a sprint finish that changes the complexion entirely.
